description: Defines structures, functions, and constants related to CSI (Channel State Information) configuration in a 5G NR context, including CSI parameters, resource periodicity, slot offsets, and resource generation functions.

classes.name: ocudu::du_csi_params
classes.description: Holds configurable CSI parameters for a DU cell, including symbol indices, resource periodicity, slot offsets, and report settings.

classes.name: ocudu::csi_helper::csi_meas_config_builder_params
classes.description: Extends du_csi_params with cell-specific parameters like PCI, RBs, ports, MCS table, and max layers for CSI measurement configuration.

methods.name: get_max_csi_rs_period
methods.description: Computes the default CSI-RS signalling period based on subcarrier spacing, constrained by TS38.214.

methods.name: is_csi_rs_period_valid
methods.description: Checks if a given CSI-RS period is valid for a specific TDD UL/DL configuration.

methods.name: find_valid_csi_rs_period
methods.description: Finds a valid CSI-RS period that conforms to TDD pattern constraints.

methods.name: derive_valid_csi_rs_slot_offsets
methods.description: Determines valid slot offsets for measurement, tracking, and interference management CSI-RS resources based on TDD pattern and other parameters.

methods.name: make_periodic_zp_csi_rs_resource_list
methods.description: Generates a list of periodic zero-precision CSI-RS resources based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: make_periodic_zp_csi_rs_resource_set
methods.description: Creates a set of periodic zero-precision CSI-RS resources.

methods.name: make_nzp_csi_rs_resource_list
methods.description: Generates a list of wideband NZP-CSI-RS resources for tracking and measurements.

methods.name: make_csi_meas_config
methods.description: Constructs a CSI measurement configuration object using provided parameters and resource list.
